vmStorage.provisioningWarning: Warning: Thin provisioning enables over-subscription. Monitor actual usage to prevent storage exhaustion.

k8sCapacity.overUtilizationWarning: Warning: Utilization exceeds 80%. Consider adding more nodes or reducing target utilization for better reliability and autoscaling headroom.
k8sCapacity.systemReservedHelp: System reserved includes OS daemons, Kubernetes components (kubelet, container runtime), and eviction thresholds. Typical values: 500-1000m CPU, 500-1000 MiB memory.
k8sCapacity.daemonSetHelp: DaemonSets run on every node (monitoring agents, log collectors, network plugins). Typical values: 200-500m CPU, 256-512 MiB memory per node.
k8sCapacity.targetUtilizationHelp: Target utilization leaves headroom for autoscaling and traffic spikes. Industry standard: 70% CPU, 80% memory. 100% leaves no buffer.
k8sCapacity.limitingFactorHelp: Kubernetes scheduling is multi-dimensional. Memory is typically the limiting factor (non-compressible, causes OOM kills).
